dailyTopNewsBrief.headline: Steelers (6-4) Week 12 Briefing: Thursday Injury Report Ahead of Broncos
bullets: Injury & Practice Status: Pittsburgh opened G Gennings Dunker's 21-day IR practice window alongside limited work for S DeShon Elliott (knee), LB Cole Holcomb (heel), and LB Nick Herbig (hip / ribs). LB Alex Highsmith (ankle) and WR Ben Skowronek (calf) did not practice Thursday, while G Gennings Dunker (knee) and WR Michael Pittman Jr. (foot (plantar fasciitis)) practiced in full [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/steelers-owner-art-rooney-ii-endorses-hc-mike-mccarthy).

Week 12 Broncos Outlook: Mike McCarthy and DC Patrick Graham open installation for the Denver Broncos (8-2, DEN -4.5, HC Sean Payton, OC Davis Webb & DC Vance Joseph (Acrisure Stadium)) as Pittsburgh prepares for a pivotal AFC matchup [Ryan Parish](https://www.behindthesteelcurtain.com/pittsburgh-steelers-analysis/178492/steelers-broncos-preview-what-to-expect-from-denvers-offense-defense-in-week-12-bo-nix-pat-surtain-sean-payton) [Brooke Pryor](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50597989/steelers-players-try-keep-focus-broncos-amid-rodgers-fallout).

AFC Playoff Trajectory: Entering Week 12 at 6-4 (2nd in AFC North • #7 Seed in AFC), Pittsburgh carries a 69.2% postseason projection, 12.1% AFC North division title mark, and 0.3% #1 Seed Bye equity into the conference stretch [NFL Trade Rumors](https://nfltraderumors.co/afc-notes-mike-mccarthy-shemar-stewart-marlon-humphrey-bengals-ravens-steelers/).

Around the Beat: As the drama surrounding Aaron Rodgers and Mike McCarthy unfolded yesterday, questions were raised about the latter’s future [Pro Football Rumors](https://www.profootballrumors.com/2026/11/steelers-owner-art-rooney-ii-endorses-hc-mike-mccarthy).
